name: hud_line_clip_clip_segment_to_current_y_bounds
description: HudLineClip::ClipSegmentToCurrentYBounds clips a 2D segment against the current Y bounds, setting endpoint clipped flags and rejecting wholly outside segments.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bd9f0 calls HudLineClip::ClipEndpointToY for outside endpoints, sets the corresponding clipped flag, returns 0 with both flags set when both endpoints are outside the same Y side, and returns 1 otherwise; HLIL has only expected verbose x87 status-word comparisons.
The native line-clip smoke verifies a visible top-bound clip with the expected interpolated endpoint and clipped flag.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4bd9f0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
